## What changes and why?

## Intended readers and example

Include a representative input and a brief before/after comparison.

## Review notes

- [ ] Mathematical statements, assumptions, and complete arguments are preserved, or deviations are explicitly identified.
- [ ] Files, references, and expected outputs are documented.
- [ ] Required scripts, tools, and external services are disclosed.
- [ ] Authorship, source provenance, and redistribution terms are included.
- [ ] No credentials, private reader data, or unrelated files are included.

Publication on the website requires maintainer review and a separate release after merge.
